plugins.name: claude-code-slides
plugins.description: Create, review, and rehearse polished HTML, Marp, and PowerPoint presentations from Codex or Claude Code with Claude Code-inspired warm terminal-editorial styling.

interface.shortDescription: Presentation workflows for Codex and Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Turn briefs, documents, URLs, and repositories into story-driven HTML, Marp, or editable PowerPoint decks. Includes narrative planning, visual direction, speaker notes, platform-aware installation, and deterministic quality checks.
defaultPrompt: Use Claude Code Slides to create a technical presentation from this repository.
Review this presentation and fix the highest-impact delivery issues.
Add speaker notes for a 12-minute engineering presentation.
